problems.title: Make a science label

context: A science class needs a program to make labels for its work. Each label must contain the word Science followed by a space and the topic name.
question.command: Write a program that does the following.
requirements: Ask for the science topic.
Join Science and the topic with one space between them.
Show the finished label.

blocks.text: Store the topic as text so its letters are kept for the label.
topic = input("Topic ")
Join Science, a space and the topic. The test topic Plants gives the complete label Science Plants.

label = "Science " + topic
print(label)

problems.solution:
topic = input("Topic ")
label = "Science " + topic
print(label)

problems.title: Find a temperature rise

context: A science class needs a program to record how much the temperature rises during an experiment. The rise is the final temperature minus the starting temperature. Both readings are in degrees Celsius.
question.command: Write a program that does the following.
requirements: Ask for the starting temperature.
Ask for the final temperature.
Subtract the starting reading from the final reading.
Show the rise in degrees.

blocks.text: Keep the starting and final temperature readings in separate variables.

start = int(input("Starting temperature "))
end = int(input("Final temperature "))
Subtract the start from the end. The test readings rise from 18 to 23, giving a rise of 5 degrees.

rise = end - start
print(f"Rise {rise} degrees")

problems.solution:
start = int(input("Starting temperature "))
end = int(input("Final temperature "))
rise = end - start
print(f"Rise {rise} degrees")

problems.title: Share seeds between trays

context: A school garden needs a program to share seeds equally between planting trays. A seed cannot be split. The program must show how many whole seeds go in each tray and how many seeds are left.
question.command: Write a program that does the following.
requirements: Ask for the number of seeds and the number of trays.
Find the number of whole seeds per tray.
Find the seeds left after sharing.
Show both answers.

blocks.text: Keep the seed count and tray count as whole numbers.

seeds = int(input("Seeds "))
trays = int(input("Trays "))
Use whole groups for the share and a remainder for the seeds left. The test gives 4 seeds per tray and 1 left.

each = seeds // trays
left = seeds % trays
print(f"Seeds per tray {each}")
print(f"Seeds left {left}")

problems.solution:
seeds = int(input("Seeds "))
trays = int(input("Trays "))
each = seeds // trays
left = seeds % trays
print(f"Seeds per tray {each}")
print(f"Seeds left {left}")

problems.title: Show five times-table facts
